services.name: Lighthouse Harbor Cruise
services.desc: Come aboard, unwind, and explore Plymouth Harbor! Duration 1 Hour, 15 Minutes About Come aboard, unwind, and appreciate one of the town's most exquisite natural treasures, Plymouth Harbor. During the journey, the Captain will provide insights into the harbor's development, spanning from the days of our early settlers to the present. On the cruise, you will have the opportunity to admire: • Plymouth Long Beach • Coastline landmarks both nearby and in the distance • The Duxbury Pier Lighthouse, affectionately known as the ""Bug Light"" by locals • Clark's Island • Saquish Beach • Various species of shoreline birdlife • Commercial fishing vessels • Many more interesting things!
